hypothesis: RIBBON-SESSION-SCOPE-DIVERGENCE (automation/overnight/queue.md 2026-07-23): J's TV chart computes the Saty ribbon over extended-hours bars; the live engine/backtest ribbon is RTH-only (deliberate 2026-06-25 parity design). analysis/recommendations/eth-ribbon-parity-2026-07-23.md validated an ETH-inclusive ribbon (backtest/tools/eth_ribbon.py) against 30 fresh TV Bar-Replay reads: stack concordance vs TV is 90% (ETH) vs 43% (RTH-only) -- the scope fix is directionally real. This study asks the DOWNSTREAM question: for the LIVE bear-rejection family's actual entries, does substituting ETH-scope ribbon state for RTH-scope change entries/outcomes specifically ON GAP MORNINGS, walked through the real production exit_manager at real OPRA fills?

gap_threshold.derivation: top-quartile (0.75 quantile) of |gap_pct| across all 385 day-inventory days carrying a gap_pct value (computed, not hand-picked: quantiles measured were 0.50->0.298, 0.60->0.378, 0.70->0.493, 0.75->0.570, 0.80->0.685, 0.90->1.063, 0.95->1.328). Population = |gap_pct| >= 0.57.

eth_coverage_requirement.derivation: a day must carry a FULL extended-hours bar series (04:00 ET premarket onward; observed cache regime is either ~141-144 bars/day [04:00-15:55] or ~190-192 bars/day [04:00-19:55] where after-hours also happened to be harvested) for the ETH-vs-RTH scope substitution to be a genuine, non-trivial comparison. This is the SAME coverage regime analysis/recommendations/eth-ribbon-parity-2026-07-23.md validated eth_ribbon.py against (Part A's 10 sample days all carried 144 or 190-192 bars) -- Part B intentionally stays inside the validated regime rather than extrapolating to the thinner 78-100-bar partial-premarket days present elsewhere in the inventory.

population.opra_requirement: day must be in day-inventory opra_days (real OPRA option coverage for fills -- no BS-synthetic pricing anywhere in this study, matching the parent bear-level-rejection family's dollars.authority clause).

heldout_definition.rule: last ceil(25%) of the 24-day gap_population BY DATE (matches the precedent edge_matrix_bear_level_rejection.py --fullhist mode already uses when a population changes: recompute heldout as last-25%-by-date rather than inherit a global split). Inheriting the PARENT bear-level-rejection study's global heldout_days (last 25% of ALL 386 opra_days by date, i.e. 2026-02-25..2026-07-17) against THIS population produces a degenerate 8-tuning/30-heldout split (most full-ETH-coverage days happen to fall late in the overall date range) -- backwards from held-out's purpose. A fresh split proper to this population is the honest choice, disclosed here before any results are read.

normal_day_bucket_for_disagreement_rate.purpose: calibration-only population for the disagreement-rate deliverable (NOT part of the trading A/B) -- same opra + full-ETH-coverage requirements, |gap_pct| < 0.57.

population.small_n_disclosure_committed_in_advance: 18 tuning days is small even before signal/fill attrition; expect n_real_fills per cell well below the OP-16 advisory evidence floor (15). This is disclosed BEFORE running: a small-n result here is a CALIBRATION finding about scope sensitivity, not a promotion-track SHIP/KILL verdict. honest_null applies (no post-hoc population widening after seeing results).

level_source.engine: backtest/lib/watchers/level_memory.py LevelMemory, IDENTICAL to the committed bear-level-rejection baseline (lookback_days=10, memory_score>=20.0) over the RTH-only continuous frame.
level_source.note: Level SOURCE is NOT the thing under test here -- only the RIBBON gate scope varies across cells (queue.md Part B frames this precisely as a ribbon-scope question, not a level-scope question). Level detection stays RTH-scope in all 3 cells.

detector_definition.base: IDENTICAL to the committed bear-level-rejection LIVE-BASELINE cell (band0.00|nth1|close_below): bar.high > level AND bar.close < level, max rejected level, no touch-count requirement, per-episode dedupe $0.35. Reused verbatim from backtest/tools/edge_matrix_bear_level_rejection.py's detect_cell_day with Cell(band=0.0, nth=1, confirm='close_below') -- not re-implemented, imported.
detector_definition.ribbon_gate_variant_by_cell: the ONLY axis that varies across the 3 cells -- see 'cells' below.

RTH.label: control, live
RTH.entry_ribbon_gate: RTH-scope ribbon stack == BEAR at the signal bar (backtest/lib/ribbon.compute_ribbon over the RTH-only close series -- byte-identical to today's production/backtest scope).
RTH.exit_ribbon_tick_scope: RTH-scope (byte-identical to today's production exit_manager ribbon_flip_back check).
RTH.rationale: this cell IS today's live/backtest baseline, unchanged -- the reference point for the other two.

ETH.entry_ribbon_gate: ETH-scope ribbon stack == BEAR at the signal bar (backtest/tools/eth_ribbon.compute_eth_ribbon, validated in eth-ribbon-parity-2026-07-23.md).
ETH.exit_ribbon_tick_scope: ETH-scope (full scope substitution, entries AND exits -- matches the queue item's literal framing: 'substituting ETH-scope ribbon state for RTH-scope').
ETH.rationale: the full 'what if the engine ran on ETH scope everywhere' variant -- entries and exits both re-scoped, for an apples-to-apples comparison against the RTH control's own entry+exit mechanics.

AGREE_ONLY.entry_ribbon_gate: RTH-scope stack == BEAR AND ETH-scope stack == BEAR (both scopes must agree BEAR) -- a strict SUBSET of the RTH cell's candidate bars by construction.
AGREE_ONLY.exit_ribbon_tick_scope: RTH-scope (same exit mechanics as the control cell).
AGREE_ONLY.rationale: isolates the ENTRY-FILTER effect of requiring cross-scope agreement, holding exit mechanics fixed and identical to the control -- answers 'does an agreement filter improve on the live baseline' without conflating it with also re-scoping exits. This is a deliberate, pre-committed asymmetry vs the ETH cell (which re-scopes both sides) -- disclosed here, not discovered after seeing results.

fixed_not_tuned.entry_window: [09:35, 15:00) ET wall -- params.json entry_no_trade_before_et/entry_no_trade_after_et, read fresh, matching the parent bear-level-rejection prereg.
fixed_not_tuned.strike: production picker: dojo sim_executor._strike_for(safe arm cfg, spot=signal close, 'P') -- ATM per V15_SAFE_TIERS, identical to the parent study.
fixed_not_tuned.qty: min(min_contracts=3, risk_gate.max_affordable_qty(...)) -- identical to the parent study.
fixed_not_tuned.entry_fill: next OPRA 5m bar at-or-after signal_ts+5min, VWAP fill -- identical to the parent study.
fixed_not_tuned.exits: the LIVE RIBBON_RIDE shape via sim_executor._resolve_exit_shape(safe arm, 'ribbon_ride', None), walked through backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager (the REAL production exit_manager core) -- identical mechanics across all 3 cells; only the ribbon_tick_df SOURCE (RTH vs ETH scope) varies per the cells table above. structure_stop_enabled=True, time_stop=15:40 (params.json).

dollars.authority: real OPRA fills only (backtest/data/options via option_pricing_real.load_contract_bars). NO Black-Scholes synthetic anywhere. Uncached-contract signals excluded from fills, counted/disclosed as NO_OPRA skips.

gates.standing_4_gate_bar: IDENTICAL definition to the parent bear-level-rejection study's cell_metrics: [g1: tuning total_pnl > 0] [g2: day majority -- winning days > covered days/2] [g3: survives ex-top1 -- total minus single best trade > 0] [g4: held-out positive -- >=1 held-out fill AND held_out_total > 0].
gates.evidence_floor: n_real_fills < 15 labeled below_evidence_floor_n15 (advisory, OP-16) -- expected to fire given the small tuning population disclosed above; does not suppress the gate computation, only labels it.

multiple_comparison_correction.procedure: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the 3 cells' p_raw values (two-sided one-sample t-test vs zero on tuning per-trade P&L, pullback_hold_bull_replay._one_sample_p convention -- reused, not re-derived).
multiple_comparison_correction.rule: sort p_(1) <= p_(2) <= p_(3); reject H0 (declare significant) for all cells with rank i such that p_(i) <= (i/3)*alpha, up to the largest such i.

disagreement_rate_deliverable.purpose: the Part-1 whisper/brief flag's calibration number (queue.md: 'how often the two ribbons disagree in the first hour on gap days vs normal days').
disagreement_rate_deliverable.definition: for every RTH bar in the FIRST HOUR (09:30-10:25 ET wall, 12 bars) of each day in {gap_population (24 days), normal_population (59 days)}, compute RTH-scope stack vs ETH-scope stack via backtest/tools/ribbon_scope_compare.py -- disagreement = stacks differ (including either side being WARMUP/None vs a resolved stack). Report disagreement RATE (disagreements / bars checked) per bucket, plus the same rate restricted to bars that are ALSO within the entry window (09:35-10:25) for a directly trade-relevant cut.
disagreement_rate_deliverable.not_part_of_the_trading_gates: purely descriptive/calibration; does not feed g1-g4 or the BH correction above.

causality: C6 -- LevelMemory and both ribbon scopes are causal by construction (guard-tested: test_level_memory.py, test_ribbon_scope_compare.py); this runner additionally reuses the parent study's causality_audit pattern (truncated-frame recompute on a sampled subset of baseline-cell signal bars) rather than re-deriving it.
rail_4_clear: research tool + JSON outputs. Touches NO params/orders/filters/heartbeat_core/strategies.py/CLAUDE.md. No broker import (guard-tested). No git operations. No live wiring. dojo/whisper.py orchestrator wiring is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this fire (Part C ships the standalone comparator only; 'the orchestrator wires the whisper/brief flag after' per the mission spec).

disclosures_committed_in_advance.not_full_engine_replication: same disclosure as the parent bear-level-rejection study -- this isolates the ribbon-gate + level-rejection detector with the two structural gates that define the family; VIX gates, volume filter, HTF modifier, entry-bar body, and tier blocks are not replicated. Constant across all 3 cells, so within-grid comparisons stay clean.
disclosures_committed_in_advance.honest_null: if no cell clears gates, or if BH correction finds no cell significant, that is the result. No post-hoc population widening, no gate relaxation after seeing results.
disclosures_committed_in_advance.eth_dollar_level_caveat: per eth-ribbon-parity-2026-07-23.md, ETH-scope stack classification carries a measured ~10% disagreement rate vs TV's own live render even within the validated coverage regime (structural SIP-vs-BATS premarket feed noise, not an engine bug) -- the ETH and AGREE_ONLY cells' entries should be read with that calibration in mind, not as a claim of pixel-exact J-eye parity.

evidence.summary: Runner ran to completion per the frozen spec; results file exists (analysis/edge-matrix/ribbon-scope-gap-morning-results-2026-07-23.json) with all 3 cells failing the standing 4-gate bar and no BH-FDR survivor.
evidence.numbers: RTH (control/live): 1/4 gates pass (g1 only), total $390.90 (n=26 fills), held_out_total -$820.84. ETH (full re-scope): 0/4 gates pass, total -$1,337.45 (n=29 fills). AGREE_ONLY (cross-scope agreement filter): 1/4 gates pass (g1 only), total $1,154.23 (n=19 fills), held_out_total -$2,392.11. BH-FDR across all 3: none significant (smallest p_raw=0.44, all fail their BH threshold). Disagreement-rate calibration: gap-day first-hour ribbon disagreement 46.5% vs normal-day 43.4% (not materially different).
evidence.rationale: None of the 3 cells (RTH control, full ETH re-scope, AGREE_ONLY cross-scope filter) clears even 2 of the 4 pre-registered gates, and no cell is statistically significant after correction. The ETH-scope substitution (validated as more TV-concordant in the sibling eth-ribbon-parity study) does NOT translate into better trading outcomes when walked through the real exit_manager on gap mornings -- production stays on RTH-scope, correctly, with evidence now attached rather than assumption.
